response.justification: Bogdan has extensive fullstack experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL-like SQL databases, plus strong architectural and open-source contributions, but his title of 'Senior' and 10+ years of experience far exceed the junior/mid-level role, and his German language skills are only basic despite high on-site requirements in Berlin.
strengths: Strong TypeScript and React experience across multiple production systems
Proven fullstack ownership with REST APIs, databases, and DevOps tooling
Active open-source contributions and technical teaching ability
concerns: Overqualified with 10+ years of senior experience for an entry-level role
Basic German proficiency conflicts with high on-site presence requirement
Recent roles emphasize AI/agent infrastructure, not renewable energy or construction tech domain
